documents.title: Solid-State Battery Overview
documents.text:
# Solid-State Batteries

Solid-state batteries replace liquid electrolytes with ceramic or polymer electrolytes. Energy density improvements of 30-40% are reported by manufacturers. CVE-2024-1234 affected legacy BMS firmware in early prototypes. Safety margins improved versus lithium-ion liquid designs.

## Manufacturing
Production costs remain higher than conventional cells through 2026.

documents.title: EU Battery Regulation Summary
documents.text:
# EU Battery Regulation

Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 requires carbon footprint declarations for EV batteries. Effective date: 18 February 2024. Reporting obligations phase in through 2027.

documents.title: EV Market Note
documents.text:
# EV Market 2026

Global EV sales growth slowed to 12% year-over-year. Solid-state commercialization timelines vary; no mass-market vehicle shipped solid-state packs at scale in Q1 2026.
